item.text: I’m treating the text as a deliberately scrambled threefold copy of one box puzzle. I’m reconstructing the repeated instructions first so the label swaps aren’t confused with moving the physical contents.

item.command: /bin/sh -lc "python3 -c \"import re,collections; s=open('puzzle_scramble.txt').read(); w=re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9]+',s); c=collections.Counter(x.lower() for x in w); print(len(w)); print(sorted(c.items(), key=lambda x:(-x[1],x[0])));\""
